proof_boundary: This proves exact physical kernel factorizations, ideal cubic lifts, lower/interior reverse recombination, finite-band/carrier/defect identities, relative-channel joins, and Abel formulas. It proves no signed finite-cell-defect or completed-current bound, Phi_B theorem, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.certificate: B_(H,N)=(R-conjugate(R_N)){conjugate(C_N)Q-conjugate(Q_N)C}+(R_x+conjugate(R_(N,x)))conjugate(C_N)C.
rows.claim: The complete Hermitian terminal coefficient has an exact rate/determinant factorization.

rows.certificate: After Q=(R+delta)C+D, B_(H,N)=conjugate(C_N)C{(R-conjugate(R_N))^2+(R-conjugate(R_N))(delta-conjugate(delta))+R_x+conjugate(R_(N,x))}+(R-conjugate(R_N)){conjugate(C_N)D-conjugate(D_N)C}.
rows.claim: Substitution of Q exposes every physical correction channel.

rows.certificate: B_(T,N)=(R-R_N){C_NQ-Q_NC}+(R_x+R_(N,x))C_NC.
rows.claim: The complete transpose terminal coefficient has the matching factorization.

rows.certificate: After Q=(R+delta)C+D, B_(T,N)=C_NC{(R-R_N)^2+R_x+R_(N,x)}+(R-R_N){C_ND-D_NC}.
rows.claim: Substitution of Q exposes the transpose correction channels.

rows.certificate: For C=1, D=delta=0, R=ix/2, R_N=-iu_N/2, and R_x=R_(N,x)=-iu_(N,x)/2, B_(H,N)^0=-(x-u_N)^2/4 and B_(T,N)^0=-(x+u_N)^2/4-iu_(N,x).
rows.claim: The correction-free kernels are explicit quadratics.
rows.proof_boundary: This specialization is not the full physical state.

rows.certificate: P_H^0=-i(x+u_N)(x-u_N)^2/4 and P_T^0=-i(x-u_N)(x+u_N)^2/4+u_(N,x)(x-u_N). Both ideal lifts are cubic; the physical correction can restore degrees four and five.
rows.claim: Both correction-free joined kernels are cubic.
rows.proof_boundary: Degree reduction is not a size bound.

rows.certificate: At x=-u_q, P_H^0=i(u_q-u_N)(u_q+u_N)^2/4 and P_T^0=i(u_q+u_N)(u_q-u_N)^2/4-u_(N,x)(u_q+u_N).
rows.claim: The ideal q-atoms display the phase-difference and phase-sum factors.
rows.proof_boundary: Neither atom family has a fixed real sign.

rows.certificate: Define Delta_H=P_H-P_H^0 and Delta_T=P_T-P_T^0 only after the full terminal conjugations above. Every term in either Delta vanishes under the simultaneous ideal specialization; no modulus or coefficient budget is taken here.
rows.claim: Physical corrections are defined after full terminal conjugation.
rows.proof_boundary: No componentwise correction budget is introduced.

rows.certificate: For P_L=i(lambda-L)P, the exact lower block is -T_1[P_L]-U_1[P_L]=i kappa L P(0)S_1+i kappa^2{[P(0)-L(P'(0)+g_0P(0))]S_2-alpha_P L P(0)S_3}.
rows.claim: Both lifted lower endpoint orders form one exact formula.

rows.certificate: Use L=log N in the Hermitian channel and L=log a+u_N in the transpose channel. The logarithms are retained until reverse recombination.
rows.claim: The two genuine lower logarithms are identified.
rows.proof_boundary: They are not hidden in O(h).

rows.certificate: For every outer mode r, -T_(1,r)[P]-U_(1,r)[P]+I_(int,r)[P]=I_P(r)-T_(N,r)[P]-U_(N,r)[P]. Thus the lower S_1/S_2/S_3 traces and the absolute interior reverse exactly to the original mode integral minus its upper boundary.
rows.claim: Two integrations by parts reverse exactly mode by mode.
rows.proof_boundary: The lower block does not vanish by itself.

rows.certificate: After symmetric summation, L_N[P]:=-T_1[P]-U_1[P]+I_N[P]=O_N[P]-T_N[P]-U_N[P], and R_N[P]=O_N[P]-T_N[P]. The lower logarithms are representation coordinates, not a separately small error and not a zero.
rows.claim: The complete lower/interior package is the outer mode sum minus its upper boundary.

rows.certificate: Let F_N[P]=sum_(r in mathcal R_N)I_P(r), let M_N[P] be the starred physical carrier from full finite Poisson inversion on [1,N], and define D_N[P]=F_N[P]-M_N[P]. Since F_N+O_N=M_N, one has R_N[P]=-D_N[P]-T_N[P] and F_N[P]+R_N[P]=M_N[P]-T_N[P].
rows.claim: Band modes, returned carriers, and their defect are distinguished exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: F_N and M_N must not be identified.

rows.certificate: The tiled finite-cell formula F_N=tau_band+M_N-E_band gives D_N=tau_band-E_band and R_N=E_band-tau_band-T_N. The finite-cell defect is the global two-sided exterior/tie package, not a new local endpoint estimate.
rows.claim: The finite-cell defect is the global exterior/tie package.
rows.proof_boundary: No cellwise absolute budget is allowed.

rows.certificate: At a half-open roster tie, F_N gains one complete mode and O_N loses the same mode. F_N+O_N and F_N+R_N are invariant; D_N and R_N change oppositely.
rows.claim: The complete mode join is invariant at reciprocal ties.

rows.certificate: For P_H=i(lambda-log N)B_(H,N), T_N[P_H]=0. Hence R_N[P_H]=-D_N[P_H] and F_N[P_H]+R_N[P_H]=M_N[P_H] exactly.
rows.claim: The Hermitian upper conditional value vanishes after relative lifting.

rows.certificate: For P_T=i(lambda-log a-u_N)B_(T,N), T_N[P_T]=-2iu_NT_N[B_(T,N)]. Hence R_N[P_T]=-D_N[P_T]+2iu_NT_N[B_(T,N)] and F_N[P_T]+R_N[P_T]=M_N[P_T]+2iu_NT_N[B_(T,N)].
rows.claim: The transpose join leaves one explicit terminal conditional term.
rows.proof_boundary: The terminal term is not dropped.

rows.certificate: If the joined finite object is the returned carrier M_N rather than the band-mode sum F_N, then M_N[P_H]+R_N[P_H]=M_N[P_H]-D_N[P_H], while the transpose channel also has +2iu_NT_N[B_(T,N)]. Dropping D_N would apply Fourier inversion twice.
rows.claim: A returned carrier cannot replace the reciprocal-band mode sum for free.

rows.certificate: M_N[P_H] is the starred q<N sum with multiplier -i(u_q-u_N)B_(H,N)(log q); its q=N atom vanishes. M_N[P_T] is the starred q<=N sum with multiplier -i(u_q+u_N)B_(T,N)(log q).
rows.claim: The exact returned sums have the parent relative multipliers.

rows.certificate: For a_q and k_q with A_j=sum_(q<=j)a_q, sum_(q=1)^N a_qk_q=A_Nk_N+sum_(q=1)^(N-1)A_q(k_q-k_(q+1)).
rows.claim: The discrete joined carrier admits exact summation by parts.

rows.certificate: Because the Hermitian relative kernel has k_N=0, its exact Abel form has no terminal boundary: sum_(q=1)^N a_qk_q=sum_(q=1)^(N-1)A_q(k_q-k_(q+1)). This is where phase-difference cancellation can be sought without detaching the finite-cell defect.
rows.claim: The Hermitian terminal Abel boundary vanishes exactly.

rows.certificate: The transpose relative kernel generally has k_N=-2iu_NB_(T,N)(log N), so its Abel terminal boundary survives and must be combined with +2iu_NT_N[B_(T,N)] and the pure terminal transpose block.
rows.claim: The transpose Abel boundary survives in an explicit terminal package.
rows.proof_boundary: It must meet the pure terminal block.

rows.certificate: Abel summation may now be applied to M_N-D_N (and the explicit transpose terminal term), not to M_N alone while silently deleting D_N. No partial-sum estimate or sign is asserted by this gate.
rows.claim: Abel must act on the carrier-defect join.

rows.certificate: The lower logarithmic traces are no longer an independent target. After exact reverse integration by parts, the live obstruction is the source-specific returned carrier minus the finite-cell defect, plus one explicit transpose terminal term.
rows.claim: The raw lower logarithms are retired as the primary obstruction.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a structural reduction only.

rows.certificate: Derive a source-specific formula and signed estimate for D_N[P_H] and D_N[P_T] from the global exterior/tie kernel, then Abel-sum M_N-D_N with the ideal cubic kept intact and Delta_H,Delta_T attached only afterward.
rows.claim: Prove or falsify a signed source-specific finite-cell-defect estimate.
rows.proof_boundary: No signed defect bound is proved.

rows.certificate: No h^2/800 reserve is claimed. The next bound must include both phase families, the correction perturbations, fixed affine row, pure terminal transpose block, and moved-tail defect before the whole-jet C1 transfer.
rows.claim: Recover the h^2/800 reserve only after all live channels are reattached.

rows.certificate: kappa=1/(2pi i), alpha_P=xi/(2pi), and e(x)=exp(2pi i x); no new geometric constant is inserted.
rows.claim: Every pi remains inherited from the fixed Fourier normalization.

rows.certificate: No signed finite-cell defect, completed mixed-current, Phi_B, contact-exclusion, Xi, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level theorem is claimed.
rows.claim: This gate is not a proof of RH.

status: joined lower/interior and finite-cell recombination proved; signed finite-cell-defect estimate open
